title: Free Restaurant No-Show Cost Calculator
meta_description: Calculate the cost of no-shows for your restaurant. Understand missed opportunities and optimise reservations.
intro: Our No-Show Cost Calculator helps UK restaurants quantify the financial impact of missed reservations. By inputting your average table cost and typical no-show rate, you can uncover how much revenue is lost due to customers not showing up. This tool empowers restaurant owners to make informed decisions about reservation management and customer engagement.
